response.reasoning_text:
fdtd-2d: each time step has three phases with dependencies between phases (ey update uses hz; ex uses hz; hz uses ex, ey). Within each phase, i rows are independent (ey: ey[i][j] depends on hz[i-1][j], hz not modified in that phase — safe). So parallelize i loop in each phase, with barriers between phases. Use single parallel region around t loop with omp for inside. Tiling not useful here (stencil bandwidth-bound, no reuse blocking). Fusion: phases have dependencies (hz needs updated ex/ey), can't fuse. Skewing: could skew but complex; keep simple.

Write:

#pragma scop
#pragma omp parallel private(t,i,j) — but t loop sequential; use single region:

#pragma omp parallel
{
  for(t...) {
    #pragma omp for
    for j ey[0][j]=...
    #pragma omp for
    ey update
    #pragma omp for
    ex update
    #pragma omp for
    hz update
  }
}
But t must be private per thread... all threads execute same t iterations; t private. Fine.
